description: This file defines the ExtensionInterface for the Twig templating engine, outlining methods that extension classes need to implement to integrate with Twig, such as providing token parsers, node visitors, filters, tests, functions, and operators.

classes.name: ExtensionInterface
classes.description: Interface implemented by extension classes for Twig, defining methods to provide token parsers, node visitors, filters, tests, functions, and operators.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns the token parser instances for extension.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns the node visitor instances for extension.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns the list of filters to be added.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns the list of tests to be added.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns the list of functions to be added.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns the list of operators (unary and binary) with their precedence and other related info.
